description: This walk visits two of the most popular peaks in Cheshire using a fantastic ridge top path. The route starts at the car park and visitor at Tegg's Nose Country Park, a few miles east of Macclesfield. From here you can pick up the Gritstone Trail and follow the waymarked path north to White Nancy. It's about 3 mile walk along the elevated, ridge top path known as the Saddle of Kerridge.Along the way there are some wonderful panoramic views over the surrounding hills and countryside of the Peak District National Park.
